en.answer: Even in the proposed scenarios, <<11673>> can be activated and resolved normally.
en.question: If a face-down Defense Position monster you control is destroyed by the effect of <<4342>> while it's still in face-down Defense Position or destroyed by battle after being flipped face-up and sent to the Graveyard, can <<11673>> be activated?
